goal: A thesis author can build real DOCX figures and tables with deterministic captions, bookmarks, template-driven widths, placement and borders.
non_goals: Do not change Markdown syntax or Parser behavior.
Do not change Template Model fields or template YAML schema.
Do not implement SEQ, REF, TOC, PAGE, NUMPAGES, OMML, footnote package parts, sections, headers or footers before task 005.
Do not implement bibliography behavior before task 006.
Do not implement atomic output replacement before task 007.
Do not add UI, network, account or AI dependencies.
expected_evidence: Observed RED and GREEN Compiler and DOCX XML tests
Typed table row and cell instruction evidence
Source-relative figure path and explicit/template width precedence evidence
Direct image relationship, media part and drawing XML assertions
Direct caption ordering and bookmark XML assertions
Direct real table and three-line border XML assertions
Full pytest, Ruff and pip check output
Offline example build and generated package inspection
Task report, independent spec review and independent quality review
unsafe_assumptions: python-docx defaults do not satisfy the selected caption and table policies.
Renderer must not parse Markdown, resolve paths, calculate numbers or generate bookmark names.
Figure paths are relative to the thesis source file rather than the process working directory.
Caption text alone does not prove that a real Word bookmark exists.
Task 004 must not claim later Word field behavior.
stop_condition: Stop if implementation crosses Parser or Domain boundaries, requires later-slice Word capabilities, edits outside allowed files, or lacks direct XML evidence.
